bg: A wide 16:9 view of the front of a small friendly train station on a sunny evening, the station building with a ticket window on the left, a station clock on the wall, a long bike rack with a few bikes along the back wall, a flower stall with buckets of flowers on the right, a bench by the wall. The paved station square in the lower half is empty.
